regions.text: hand of God. We dare not forget today that
regions.explanation: From 70.15s to 75.62s (“hand of God. We dare not forget today that”), the share of energy above 2 kHz dropped to 0.2% from 5.2% (-96%); that is 3.3× the reference speaker's natural word-to-word variation. Energy above 2 kHz carries consonant bursts and fricatives (t, k, s, f); losing it blurs word boundaries and makes the speech sound muffled even at normal volume. Fix: Open the mouth more and finish final consonants crisply.
